lines.text: Four Claude Code agents. Four terminals.
lines.caption: 4 agents. 4 terminals.

lines.text: And every one keeps stopping to ask. Can I run npm test? Can I edit this file?
lines.say: And every one keeps stopping to ask. [[slnc 120]] Can I run N P M test? [[slnc 80]] Can I edit this file?
lines.caption: Each one stops to ask permission

lines.text: So you switch windows all day, just to say yes.
lines.caption: So you switch windows. All day.

lines.text: Meet Nod.
lines.caption: Meet Nod

lines.text: It puts your agents in the MacBook notch.
lines.caption: Your agents, in the notch

lines.text: Hover, and you see what each agent is doing.
lines.caption: Hover for progress

lines.text: Its task, the steps it's done, and the tool running right now.
lines.caption: Task · steps · the live tool

lines.text: Click an avatar to check on another session.
lines.caption: One avatar per session

lines.text: When an agent needs you, the notch asks.
lines.caption: When an agent needs you, it asks

lines.text: Option-Return approves it.
lines.caption: {opt}{ret} to approve

lines.text: You never leave your editor.
lines.caption: You never leave your editor

lines.text: Every request gets a plain-English risk read-out.
lines.caption: A plain-English risk read-out

lines.text: Green is read-only, inside the repo.
lines.caption: Green: read-only, inside the repo

lines.text: Amber is a code edit, and you see the real diff.
lines.caption: Amber: a code edit, with the diff

lines.text: Red means stop.
lines.caption: Red means stop

lines.text: Delete fourteen files outside this repo? It tells you why.
lines.caption: It tells you why

lines.text: Deny is the default. Allowing takes a deliberate hold.
lines.caption: Deny by default. Hold to allow.

lines.text: Nod learns how you decide, on your Mac, and flags anything unusual for you.
Run as many agents as you like. Requests queue up, one keystroke each.
lines.caption: Many agents. One queue.

lines.text: Always allow npm test here, and next time it just goes through.
lines.say: Always allow N P M test here, [[slnc 60]] and next time, it just goes through.
lines.caption: Always allow npm test here

lines.text: Nod. Approve your agents from the notch.
lines.say: Nod. [[slnc 250]] Approve your agents from the notch.
